01 / ABOUT

Curious about how things work.
Committed to building them.

My work starts with a question, whether that means following a line precisely, creating a tool for a real problem, or finding the right composition in a photograph. I care about the process as much as the result.

02 / PROJECTS

The things I make.

Each project is a different way to learn by doing.

01 / DURONTOJATRA

Building for a world that needs better tools.

Team DurontoJatra brings together ideas around water, movement, and practical engineering. Aqua Guard and a dumbwaiter concept show two directions of that work.

  • Aqua Guard
  • Dumbwaiter
  • Teamwork

02 / PAGLA GHORA LFR

Fast decisions on a defined path.

Line-following robots taught me that clean sensing, precise control, and rapid iteration matter when every millisecond changes the route.

  • Line following
  • Electronics
  • Control

03 / PERSONAL BUILDS

Small systems, useful ideas.

From a CPU scheduling project to a compact nRF-based device, these are personal experiments in software, hardware, and getting the details right.

  • Problem solving

04 / BEST CLICKS

Stories found in a frame.

Photography gives me time to notice the quiet details.

01 / BUP · AUGUST RAIN

Between Light and Shadow

Taken after a mild August rain at BUP, this quiet pause sits between light and shadow. A friend appears in two versions: one in the fading sun, one in the reflection. It is about carrying dreams and doubts at once, and learning to walk with both.

02 / TAIF

Reaching Skyward

Under Taif’s clear sky, the white marble building seems to rise into a quiet conversation with the blue above. It holds a simple sense of aspiration: the desire to build, rise, and leave something lasting.

03 / REFLECTION

Where Light Lingers

What exists above is echoed beneath, blurring the line between reality and reflection. Like light, moments do not simply disappear; they remain in quieter forms.

04 / NATURE

Precision in Flight

Resting on a vibrant flower, the butterfly feels both delicate and powerful. Its patterned wings speak of transformation and survival, where a small life holds extraordinary detail.

05 / KURMITOLA

A Place That Still Lives

The sun sets over corridors I once walked every day. Time has moved on, but the place still holds echoes of laughter, lessons, and the moments that shaped a decade of my life.

06 / GARDEN

Under Garden Lights

An ordinary garden corner changes character after dark. The hibiscus catches the nearby light and turns a familiar flower into a small stage of colour and texture.

07 / CLOSE-UP

In Full Bloom

Moving close changes the scale of the world. This small flower becomes all colour, lines, and light—proof that a familiar subject can still surprise you when you give it attention.

08 / CITYSCAPE

A Wider View

From above, the city loosens into water, trees, and open sky. It is a reminder that even a busy place can reveal its calm when you change your point of view.
